description.zh-CN: 把景点照片转成右侧水彩插画、左侧留白排版的横版旅行明信片。预览为自制示意，未用原帖照片编辑复测。 来源案例仅作视觉参考，生成效果尚未在本模板中复测。
description.en-US: Watercolor Travel Postcard. The source example is a visual reference, not a verified output of this preset.

zh-CN.prompt: 使用一张有权使用、没有第三方水印的景点照片，保留地点主体与拍摄视角，将它设计成复古旅行手账风的横版明信片平面图。右侧约 60% 区域把原景转绘成清透水彩插画，保留可辨识的建筑、山水和空间关系；使用自然晕染、纸张颗粒、不规则笔触边缘，让插画柔和融入暖米白纸面。插画略微收小，四周有宽纸边，上下留出呼吸感，笔触不延伸到画布边缘。左侧疏朗排版：小编号、简短英文主题标题、LOCATION 与 DATE 标签及空白横线；底部放三枚从照片提取的手绘色块。标题用复古衬线字体，整体清新、舒展、有旅行收藏感。只输出平整的明信片设计本身，不要桌面、手持、相框、透视变形、界面元素或水印。

en-US.prompt: Use a travel photograph that you have rights to use and that contains no third-party watermark. Preserve its recognizable landmark and viewpoint, and turn it into a flat horizontal vintage travel-journal postcard design. On the right, use about 60% of the canvas for a transparent watercolor rendition of the original scene, preserving distinctive architecture, landscape and spatial relationships. Add natural pigment bleeds, paper grain and irregular brush edges fading softly into warm off-white paper. Scale the illustration down slightly with broad paper margins and breathing room above and below; keep the brushwork away from the canvas edges. On the left, arrange a small number, a short English subject title, LOCATION and DATE labels with blank ruled lines; place three hand-painted color swatches sampled from the scene at the bottom. Use a vintage serif title. Keep it fresh, spacious and collectible. Output only the flat finished postcard, not a tabletop, hand-held card, frame, perspective mockup, UI elements or watermark.
